class.name: OpenXRAndroidGeospatialPose
class.description: Represents a position and orientation relative to the Earth, using coordinates relative to the WGS84 ellipsoid. When returned by [method OpenXRAndroidGeospatialExtension.transform_to_geospatial_pose], the pose also includes accuracy and validity information.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates a new [OpenXRAndroidGeospatialPose] with the given orientation, latitude, longitude, and altitude.

method.name: is_orientation_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the orientation data in this pose is valid. When [code]false[/code], the [member orientation] and [member orientation_yaw_accuracy] fields should not be used.

method.name: is_position_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the position data in this pose is valid. When [code]false[/code], the [member latitude], [member longitude], [member altitude], [member horizontal_accuracy], and [member vertical_accuracy] fields should not be used.

members.member: The altitude in meters above the WGS84 ellipsoid.

The estimated horizontal accuracy of the position, defined as the radius in meters of the 68% confidence circle around the latitude and longitude. Only set when the pose is returned by [method OpenXRAndroidGeospatialExtension.transform_to_geospatial_pose].
The latitude in degrees, between -90 and +90.
The longitude in degrees, between -180 and +180.
The orientation relative to an east-up-south (EUS) coordinate system, where +X is East, +Y is Up, and +Z is South. This coordinate system depends on the precise position.

The estimated yaw accuracy of the orientation, defined as the radius in degrees of the 68% confidence level around the orientation yaw angle. Only set when the pose is returned by [method OpenXRAndroidGeospatialExtension.transform_to_geospatial_pose].

The estimated vertical accuracy of the position in meters, defined as the 68% confidence distance around the altitude. Only set when the pose is returned by [method OpenXRAndroidGeospatialExtension.transform_to_geospatial_pose].
